skill_title: Synchronous reset at an external memory interface
pattern: Raw synchronous reset combinationally changes an external memory transaction between clock edges.
when: Authoring integration glue for a declared synchronous reset and external synchronous memory protocol.
what: Choose and declare the reset sampling boundary from the input and memory protocol; sample the reset inhibit, preserve write-enable/address/data alignment and avoid a write-only pipeline. Retain the independent failing control unchanged and verify the affected held-reset retention and normal boot.
example: A short reset pulse occurs while a valid memory write is held between rising edges. A raw reset gate withdraws the strobe; a sampled inhibit leaves that transaction unchanged until the sampling edge. A pre-edge write may commit at that edge under the declared memory protocol.
generality: The sampling boundary and aligned transaction tuple apply to integration around any reused processor or memory adapter; neither IP identity nor memory capacity selects behavior.
classification: Bucket B contextual author/skill judgment; not a deterministic program fix
